title: Crypto market research engine
description: Python research engine for Binance USD-M Futures. It records market data, computes TradingView-matching indicators, detects support/resistance levels, logs every level visit and its outcome, tests trading signals against random entries in the same trend, and runs pre-registered forward tests of frozen rules (s1h12: the Strategy-1 EMA retest on 1h candles, counted from 2026-11-23). Public market data only; it places no orders.
